description: Defines custom GraphQL scalar types for JSON, Hex, Decimal, BigInt, DateTime, CalendarDay, and Empty, along with related utility functions and external dependencies.

methods.name: hexToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a Uint8Array, with validation for hex characters and even length.

methods.name: bytesToHex
methods.description: Converts a Uint8Array to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Parses an ISO 8601 date-time string into a Date object, with validation.

methods.name: validateCalendarDay
methods.description: Validates that a string matches the ISO 8601 full-date format.
